name: uma-build-advisor
description: Repository-grounded Umamusume build advice with a ChatGPT build view and private inventory tools.

interface.longDescription: Plan server-specific Umamusume builds in ChatGPT using the versioned Japanese or Global game-data catalog and your private inventory. Connect the remote MCP server through OpenAI Secure MCP Tunnel for private data access and updates. Includes fresh strategy research, six-card deck recommendations, legacy candidates, substitutions, and an interactive recommendation view. Native ChatGPT mobile availability depends on current MCP app support; a separate text-only GPT Actions route is documented as an optional fallback.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a Japanese-server Umamusume build using my catalog and inventory.
